title: Unpolish configuration
description: Shared, version-controlled project presets for Unpolish. Everything is optional; omitted values use built-in defaults.

id.description: Short project id. Namespaces local drafts in browser storage so prototypes on the same origin don't share them.

enabled.description: Set false to load the script without starting it (for example in production builds).

ui.description: hidden removes the launcher; the toggle shortcut still opens the panel.

webFonts.description: Load Balsamiq Sans, IBM Plex and Nunito from Google Fonts when a theme uses them. When false, system fallbacks are used.

exclude.description: CSS selectors for extra regions Unpolish must not restyle (original look, no filter). Always ignored: data-unpolish-ignore and the Unpolish UI. Maps, images, canvas, video, iframe, svg internals, object and embed are skipped automatically and shown with a single CSS filter on the container.

include.description: CSS selectors that opt a skipped region back into classification. Equivalent to data-unpolish="keep" on the element. Do not include huge maps.

mapMarkers.description: How map marker icons are themed. pane (default) applies one cheap CSS filter on the Leaflet marker pane (or OpenLayers overlay container). img applies a stylesheet filter to marker images. original keeps icons full color. Never classifies or inline-filters each marker. Opt out with mapMarkers: "original", or data-unpolish-ignore on the marker pane (pane) or a marker (img). Has no effect on Google Maps (no separate marker pane); use skipFilter.maps "original" to keep GMP markers in colour.

skipFilter.description: Whether skipped maps and/or images get the theme's skip/hybrid CSS filter. theme (default) keeps current behaviour. original leaves those skipped regions unfiltered (not classified) — use this on always-live maps so Sketch does not greyscale the basemap or flash busy↔still. A string "original" turns both off. Per element: data-unpolish-filter="original".

roles.description: Selector → role hints for custom components the automatic classifier gets wrong.

toggle.description: Opens and closes the panel, e.g. "\\" or "Alt+U".

themes.description: Direct theme shortcuts that work with the panel closed, e.g. { "sketch": "Alt+S" }.
Tuned presets per theme. Unlisted settings use the built-in defaults.

overrides.description: Project-specific CSS, scoped to a theme (or "*" for all themes) and nested under html[data-unpolish]. Use !important to win over Unpolish rules. Variables such as --up-ink, --up-surface, --up-line and --up-accent are available.

details.description: Strength of the theme's own treatment, 0 (off) to 100. Older configs may use true/false.

images.description: theme matches images to the theme (default); mono is black and white. simplified is an older name for theme.
